# E02 等价无穷小替换

完整知识单元课堂参考草稿，按数学内容选择组织方式。本示例仅供理解教学行为，实际项目应重新设计板书、布局、动画和节奏；关联题规则以当前项目为准。以下代码尚未经过真实成片验收。

```python title=scene_01
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class E02Part1(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("等价无穷小替换", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("E02_1_1", "当两个无穷小的比值趋于一，就称它们在该过程中等价。", "", tts_text="当两个无穷小的比值趋于一，就称它们在该过程中等价。")
        line_1 = MathTex(r"\alpha\sim\beta\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad \lim\frac{\alpha}{\beta}=1", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E02_1_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("E02_1_1")
        self.start_cue("E02_1_2", "当 x 趋于零，正弦 x 与 x 等价，e 的 x 次方减一也与 x 等价。", "", tts_text="当 x 趋于零，正弦 x 与 x 等价，e 的 x 次方减一也与 x 等价。")
        line_2 = MathTex(r"\sin x\sim x,\quad e^x-1\sim x\quad(x\to0)", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_2.next_to(line_1, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_2), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E02_1_2", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2)
        self.end_cue("E02_1_2")
```

```python title=scene_02
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class E02Part2(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("等价无穷小替换", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("E02_2_1", "在乘除结构中替换相应因子，等价因子的比值趋于一，因此不改变存在的极限。", "", tts_text="在乘除结构中替换相应因子，等价因子的比值趋于一，因此不改变存在的极限。")
        line_1 = MathTex(r"\frac{\sin x}{e^x-1}=\frac{\sin x}{x}\frac{x}{e^x-1}", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E02_2_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("E02_2_1")
        self.start_cue("E02_2_2", "加减结构不能逐项随意替换，主要项可能抵消。例如正弦 x 减 x 的主项是负六分之一乘 x 的三次方。", "", tts_text="加减结构不能逐项随意替换，主要项可能抵消。")
        line_2 = MathTex(r"\sin x-x\sim-\frac{x^3}{6}\quad(x\to0)", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_2.next_to(line_1, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_2), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E02_2_2", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2)
        self.end_cue("E02_2_2")
        self.start_cue("E02_2_3", "若需要更高阶信息，应使用泰勒展开等方法。", "", tts_text="若需要更高阶信息，应使用泰勒展开等方法。")
        line_3 = Text("加减结构注意抵消", color=BLACK, font_size=28)
        line_3.next_to(line_2, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_3), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E02_2_3", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2, line3=line_3)
        self.end_cue("E02_2_3")
```

```python title=scene_03
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class E02Part3(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("等价无穷小替换", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("E02_3_1", "例题一：求 正弦 x 除以 x 的极限。", "", tts_text="例题一：求 正弦 x 除以 x 的极限。")
        line_1 = MathTex(r"\lim\limits_{x\to0}\frac{\sin x}{x}=1", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E02_3_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("E02_3_1")
        self.start_cue("E02_3_2", "例题二：求 e 的 x 次方减一，除以 正弦 x 的极限。", "", tts_text="例题二：求 e 的 x 次方减一，除以 正弦 x 的极限。")
        line_2 = MathTex(r"\lim\limits_{x\to0}\frac{e^x-1}{\sin x}", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_2.next_to(line_1, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_2), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E02_3_2", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2)
        self.end_cue("E02_3_2")
        self.start_cue("E02_3_3", "上下两个因子均与 x 等价，极限为一。", "", tts_text="上下两个因子均与 x 等价，极限为一。")
        line_3 = MathTex(r"\lim\limits_{x\to0}\frac{x}{x}=1", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_3.next_to(line_2, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_3), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E02_3_3", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2, line3=line_3)
        self.end_cue("E02_3_3")
```

```python title=scene_04
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class E02Part4(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("等价无穷小替换", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("E02_4_1", "记住变化过程和比值趋于一的定义。优先在乘除因子中使用，加减抵消要特别谨慎。", "", tts_text="记住变化过程和比值趋于一的定义。优先在乘除因子中使用，加减抵消要特别谨慎。")
        line_1 = Text("定义 → 乘除替换 → 警惕抵消", color=BLACK, font_size=28)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        line_1.set_color("#1D4ED8")
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E02_4_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("E02_4_1")
```
